fix.problem: First-time home buyers in Indonesia face many KPR mortgage options, bank requirements and property legality checks (SHM, SHGB, HGB). Fees are unclear and fraud on land titles is a real worry. Bank-by-bank comparison is manual, and many buyers rely on developer sales agents who are not neutral. Mistakes on title checks are costly.
fix.solution: The original concept was a KPR advisor that compares banks, explains fees and requirements, checks title types and guides the purchase. Property portals and banks already provide free KPR comparison and applications, so it is outdated. Notaries (PPAT) still have to do the legal title checks, which software cannot replace. Banks also run their own pre-approval apps, and lead revenue is captured by the portals, so there is no gap for a new entrant.
